mapper.select: SELECT E.EMPLOYEE_ID, E.EMPLOYEE_NAME, E.DEPARTMENT, E.POSITION_TITLE, TO_CHAR(E.HIRE_DATE, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS HIRE_DATE, TRUNC(MONTHS_BETWEEN(SYSDATE, E.HIRE_DATE) / 12) AS YEARS_WORKED, FN_FORMAT_AMOUNT(E.SALARY) AS SALARY, NVL(E.COMMISSION_PCT, 0) * 100 || '%' AS COMMISSION, FN_FORMAT_AMOUNT(E.SALARY * (1 + NVL(E.COMMISSION_PCT, 0))) AS TOTAL_COMPENSATION, NVL(M.EMPLOYEE_NAME, '(최상위)') AS MANAGER_NAME, E.EMAIL, E.PHONE_EXT FROM EMPLOYEES E LEFT JOIN EMPLOYEES M ON E.MANAGER_ID = M.EMPLOYEE_ID WHERE E.EMPLOYEE_ID = #{employeeId}

SELECT EMPLOYEE_ID, EMPLOYEE_NAME, DEPARTMENT, POSITION_TITLE, MANAGER_ID, LEVEL AS ORG_LEVEL, LPAD(' ', (LEVEL - 1) * 4) || EMPLOYEE_NAME AS ORG_TREE, SYS_CONNECT_BY_PATH(EMPLOYEE_NAME, ' > ') AS FULL_PATH, CONNECT_BY_ISLEAF AS IS_LEAF FROM EMPLOYEES START WITH MANAGER_ID IS NULL CONNECT BY PRIOR EMPLOYEE_ID = MANAGER_ID ORDER SIBLINGS BY DEPARTMENT, EMPLOYEE_NAME

SELECT EMPLOYEE_ID, EMPLOYEE_NAME, DEPARTMENT, POSITION_TITLE, LEVEL - 1 AS DEPTH, LPAD('└─ ', (LEVEL - 1) * 3) || EMPLOYEE_NAME AS TREE_VIEW FROM EMPLOYEES START WITH EMPLOYEE_ID = #{managerId} CONNECT BY PRIOR EMPLOYEE_ID = MANAGER_ID ORDER SIBLINGS BY EMPLOYEE_NAME

SELECT NVL(DEPARTMENT, '전체') AS DEPARTMENT, COUNT(*) AS EMP_COUNT, FN_FORMAT_AMOUNT(ROUND(AVG(SALARY), 0)) AS AVG_SALARY, FN_FORMAT_AMOUNT(MIN(SALARY)) AS MIN_SALARY, FN_FORMAT_AMOUNT(MAX(SALARY)) AS MAX_SALARY, FN_FORMAT_AMOUNT(SUM(SALARY)) AS TOTAL_SALARY, FN_FORMAT_AMOUNT(ROUND(SUM(SALARY * NVL(COMMISSION_PCT, 0)), 0)) AS TOTAL_COMMISSION FROM EMPLOYEES GROUP BY ROLLUP(DEPARTMENT) ORDER BY DEPARTMENT NULLS LAST

SELECT DEPARTMENT, COUNT(*) AS EMP_COUNT, LISTAGG(EMPLOYEE_NAME || '(' || POSITION_TITLE || ')', ', ') WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY SALARY DESC) AS MEMBER_LIST FROM EMPLOYEES GROUP BY DEPARTMENT ORDER BY DEPARTMENT
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO EMPLOYEES ( EMPLOYEE_ID, EMPLOYEE_NAME, DEPARTMENT, POSITION_TITLE, HIRE_DATE, SALARY, COMMISSION_PCT, MANAGER_ID, EMAIL, PHONE_EXT ) VALUES ( SEQ_EMPLOYEE.NEXTVAL, #{employeeName}, #{department}, #{positionTitle}, NVL(TO_DATE(#{hireDate}, 'YYYY-MM-DD'), SYSDATE), #{salary}, #{commissionPct}, #{managerId}, #{email}, #{phoneExt} )
mapper.update: UPDATE EMPLOYEES SET SALARY = GREATEST( ROUND(SALARY * (1 + #{raiseRate} / 100), -3), SALARY ), COMMISSION_PCT = DECODE(#{adjustCommission}, 'Y', LEAST(NVL(COMMISSION_PCT, 0) + 0.02, 0.30), COMMISSION_PCT) WHERE EMPLOYEE_ID = #{employeeId}
mapper.select:
SELECT LOG_ID, TABLE_NAME, OPERATION, SUBSTR(NVL(OLD_VALUE, ''), 1, 200) AS OLD_VALUE_SHORT, SUBSTR(NVL(NEW_VALUE, ''), 1, 200) AS NEW_VALUE_SHORT, NVL(CHANGED_BY, 'SYSTEM') AS CHANGED_BY, TO_CHAR(CHANGED_AT, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS CHANGED_AT FROM AUDIT_LOG WHERE 1 = 1
AND TABLE_NAME = #{tableName}
AND CHANGED_AT >= TO_TIMESTAMP(#{startDate}, 'YYYY-MM-DD')
AND CHANGED_AT <= TO_TIMESTAMP(#{endDate} || ' 23:59:59', 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS')
ORDER BY CHANGED_AT DESC
